setting: A Cossack sloboda and the old mixed oak, maple and hazel forest beyond a ravine (balka), late summer 1552: dense undergrowth, fallen oaks, ferns, game trails, shafts of early morning sun through the canopy.

characters.trokhym: 40-year-old burly Cossack hunter, ruddy weathered face, greying chestnut forelock, thick chestnut mustache, dark green svyta, brown sharovary, wide brown sash, spanning key on a cord
characters.vasyl: 36-year-old lean Cossack hunter, narrow hawkish face, long black forelock behind the ear, black drooping mustache, scar on the chin, faded blue svyta, grey sharovary, red sash
characters.bear: huge old male brown bear, dark-brown coat with grizzled tips, massive shoulder hump, scarred muzzle
characters.forest_workers: sloboda woodcutters in sweaty linen shirts and sharovary, forelocks and straw hats, axes on their shoulders
characters.searchers: sloboda Cossacks in grey and brown svytas and sheepskin kalpaks, long mustaches, samopals and rohach spears

palette: Passages: sepia and graphite on warm ivory paper, fine organic pen and pencil hatching inspired by Abraham van Westerveld. Cover only: ultra-realistic full-color cinematic photograph.
notes: Trokhym and Vasyl are inseparable hunting partners, taken for brothers in the sloboda, friends since the Ochakiv campaign. Each carries two heavy wheel-lock samopals (spanned with a key) and a rohach boar spear; for the hunt their faces, clothes and horses are smeared with crushed leaves and dark berry juice to mask their scent. Their two horses (a bay and a black) are tethered by a maple. The bear is photographed like wildlife photography, anatomically correct. The mauling is never shown; deaths are quiet and respectful.
cover_palette: deep forest greens and mossy browns, golden morning shafts of light, the bear's dark fur, Vasyl's red sash and faded blue svyta as the only colour accents, white powder smoke.
illustration_notes: 13 passage drawings. Distinguish stocky greying Trokhym from lean dark-haired Vasyl. Preserve which wheel-lock firearm fires in each branch. In the fatal aftermath the hunters are covered bodies, not members of the search party.
